title: Here lies love has been reimagined at @Center Theatre Group so obviou...
transcript: Just got out of Hear Lies Love at the Mark Taper, which is a vastly different reimagining of Hear Lies Love, the Fat Boy Slim David Byrne musical that was on Broadway a few years ago. I'm going to pop in a clip of the encore song at the end of this. So you kind of get a look at the sound and design of this production. But instead having the show be in this immersive nightclub setting like it was in previous productions, it is now reimagined to sort of be reenacted as part of a A variety show of sorts. And so you have the audience sitting down in what appears to be kind of like a. A sound stage. That's at least the sense that I got, that there's not, like, cameras everywhere, so we don't fully get that sense, but that's. That's kind of what I. I imagine that they're going for in this, and that, for the most part, works. It's a vastly different production, and so there are aspects of the old one that I definitely miss. There are aspects of this, however, that I do think work a little better. And that's kind of the beauty of theatre, is that somebody can come in with the same base material and bring something completely different to the same story and bring out new aspects of that story. It's what I. What I love about going to see shows in different productions of Them. If you're in the LA Area, I highly recommend getting over to the taper. It is very much still in preview, so maybe give them a week. They're kinda working out some of the pacing right now. Some of the audience participation, and there is still audience participation in the show. They have not completely lost that. They do try to incorporate it at certain moments. Also added in a new song. They added in The Whole Man, which was a song off of the concept album that they've put now into the show itself. Overall, this cast is absolutely incredible and I love this music. It's a very experimental show, so it's definitely not for everybody. I highly recommend listening to just a couple songs off the cast album because this is very music heavy and so if you're not vibing with the music, this may not be the show for you. But I really love what they've done with it and I'm so glad that I got to catch it. And tickets are available on Ticketmaster. They have both a lottery and a rush. I was a little scared because the rush hasn't been popping up everyday, so be aware of that. So I ended up buying a full price ticket and they're still pretty affordable. My ticket was $50 full view. They have full price tickets as low as $23 though. Be aware there are gonna be some parts of the theatre that are going To be a little partial view, so keep that in mind. But overall, I'm so glad that I got to catch this. And here is a look at that encore song.
